package.name: people_oracle
package.description:
THE GROUND-TRUTH PERCEPTION PRODUCER (Phase 12). Converts HuNavSim's `people_msgs/People` into the canonical `Track` contract, so the simulated and real perception paths present the controller with ONE type.
It is the upper bound: identity is never lost, position is never wrong, nothing ever coasts. Any gap between the controller's behaviour on these tracks and on real fusion tracks is therefore attributable to perception, not to the controller.
A LIBRARY, NOT A NODE. `Track` is an in-process Python contract with no ROS .msg (deliberately — that would couple the controller to a distro), so the consuming node keeps its own /people subscription and hands the message here. NO rclpy, NO numpy, NO people_msgs import: the message is duck-typed, which keeps this pure stdlib and desk-testable.
NOTE: ground truth has pos_std = vel_std = 0.0. A controller evaluated only against this producer has a degenerate footprint of uncertainty and behaves as type-1. Injectable noise is the next step and is what makes the IT2 claim measurable; it is deliberately not built yet.
